# ShowTodo

> ShowTodo is an open, public-first todo network for creators, learners, and builders to share their daily journey, overcome procrastination through social accountability, and build in public.

ShowTodo transforms isolated personal todo lists into an open stream of real-time progress across the open web. It enables quiet companionship, workflow discovery, transparent achievement tracking, and seamless integration with AI agents and browser extensions without toxic vanity metrics.

## Core Value Pillars

- **Social Accountability**: Publishing daily tasks turns private procrastination into visible public commitment.
- **Shared Goals & Topic Hashing**: Tasks sharing identical content or topic hashes automatically cluster together, connecting people working toward the same ambitions.
- **Workflow Discovery**: Observers can witness authentic daily breakdowns, study practical focus habits, and emulate effective execution patterns from active peers.
- **Quiet Encouragement**: Peers celebrate finished milestones using distraction-free emoji reaction signals (Cheer, Salute, Fire, Rock, Celebrate, Heart) without noisy comment threads.
- **Build in Public**: Public todo profiles, chronological milestone feeds, and 365-day activity heatmaps create verifiable proof of consistency.
- **AI-Agent & Ecosystem Ready**: Native Model Context Protocol (MCP) server, 1:N personal access tokens (API Keys), official Chrome Extension, and Google OAuth.

## Public Web Pages

- [Home Feed](https://www.showtodo.com/): Real-time public stream of todos, filtered by status (all, active, done) and category (dev, study, fitness, finance, life).
- [What is ShowTodo](https://www.showtodo.com/about): Comprehensive explanation of transparency, design ethos, and why public accountability works.
- [Trending Goals](https://www.showtodo.com/trending): Popular shared tasks and communal goals aggregated by content-addressable topic hash.
- [Goals Directory](https://www.showtodo.com/goals): Full directory of shared objectives and participant networks.
- [Stats Dashboard](https://www.showtodo.com/stats): Global platform metrics, activity distributions, and completion velocity.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.showtodo.com/privacy): Privacy standards, transparent data handling, GDPR/CCPA rights, and user data ownership policies.

## Ecosystem & Developer Access

- **Model Context Protocol (MCP) Endpoint**: `https://www.showtodo.com/api/mcp`
  Connect Claude Desktop, Cursor, or autonomous AI agents via Streamable HTTP (POST) or Server-Sent Events (SSE GET).
- **Personal Access Tokens (API Keys)**: Manage 1:N scoped tokens (`st_live_...`) in account settings (`/settings/apikey`) for MCP agents and automated REST API scripts. Authenticate requests via `Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>`.
- **Authentication**: Seamless Google OAuth one-click login, verified email/password security, or frictionless anonymous email auto-provisioning.
- **Chrome Extension (Quick Post)**: Official browser extension to capture ideas or highlighted web text and publish public todos with keyboard shortcuts (`Cmd/Ctrl+Enter`).

## AI Agent MCP Capabilities (`/api/mcp`)

- **Registered Tools**:
  - `create_todo`: Create and publish a public task with content-addressable topic indexing.
  - `list_my_todos`: List authenticated user's active and completed todos.
  - `update_todo_status`: Transition todo lifecycle status (`pending`, `in_progress`, `done`, `abandoned`).
  - `add_progress_note`: Append milestone progress logs to a task.
  - `discover_topics`: Search and explore trending communal goals.
  - `react_to_todo`: Cheer on peers with authentic Unicode emoji reactions.
- **Exposed Resources**:
  - `showtodo://me/overview`: Personal task and status summary.
  - `showtodo://users/{handle}/todolist`: Markdown representation of public todolists.
  - `showtodo://topics/{topicHash}`: Activity stream and participants for a shared goal.
  - `showtodo://stats/summary`: Platform-wide productivity metrics.
- **Guided Prompts**:
  - `daily_standup`: Interactive daily plan review and task structuring.
  - `breakdown_goal`: Decompose monolithic goals into atomic actionable ShowTodo tasks.
  - `companion_cheer`: Peer encouragement and progress cheering helper.

## Public REST API Endpoints for Agents

ShowTodo provides clean JSON endpoints for programmatic discovery and AI agents (supports `Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>` for user actions):

- [Public Daily Feed](https://www.showtodo.com/api/daily): `GET /api/daily?limit=20&cursor=...&category=...` - Returns daily public task cards grouped by date and topic.
- [Trending Topics](https://www.showtodo.com/api/topics): `GET /api/topics?limit=10` - Returns trending shared goals and participant counts.
- [Topic Detail](https://www.showtodo.com/api/topics/{hash}): `GET /api/topics/{hash}` - Returns todos and participants associated with a topic hash.
- [Todo Details](https://www.showtodo.com/api/todos/{id}): `GET /api/todos/{id}` - Returns full details, reactions, and timeline for a single public task.
- [User Profile](https://www.showtodo.com/api/users/{id}): `GET /api/users/{id}` - Returns user nickname, handle, bio, and total stats.
- [User Heatmap](https://www.showtodo.com/api/users/{id}/heatmap): `GET /api/users/{id}/heatmap` - Returns 365-day activity density for verifiable proof of work.
- [Platform Stats](https://www.showtodo.com/api/stats): `GET /api/stats` - Returns global task totals and category breakdowns.
